description: This file defines a React functional component called NavBar, which renders the top navigation bar for a web application. The NavBar includes links for browsing questions, asking questions, notifications, moderation and admin areas (conditionally rendered based on user roles), theme toggling, and user authentication actions such as login, registration, profile access, and logout.

methods.name: NavBar({ onToggleTheme, currentTheme })
methods.description: React functional component that renders the navigation bar with links and buttons, handling user authentication state and theme toggling.
